local-plan.name: Local plans
local-plan.summary: A local plan sets out the vision and framework for the future development of a local planning authority area. It is prepared by the local planning authority and, once adopted, is used to decide planning applications.

minerals-plan.name: Minerals plans
minerals-plan.summary: A minerals plan sets out where and how minerals such as sand, gravel and crushed rock will be extracted in an area. It is prepared by a minerals planning authority.

waste-plan.name: Waste plans
waste-plan.summary: A waste plan sets out how an area will manage the waste it produces, including where new waste facilities can be built. It is prepared by a waste planning authority.
